macros.name: setpresyl
macros.doc: Command for changing the horizontal space to the right of the syllogism (def=2em).

macros.name: setsylergo
macros.doc: Command for changing the text that begins the conclusion.

macros.name: setsylergosign
macros.doc: Command for changing the sign that goes after the conclusion text (def=∴).

macros.name: setsyllabel
macros.doc: Command for changing the horizonal space between the label and the syllogism (def=1em).

macros.name: setsylpuncc
macros.doc: Command for changing the punctuation after the conclusion (def=.).

macros.name: setsylpuncpa
macros.doc: Command for changing the punctuation after the first premiss (def=;).

macros.name: setsylpuncpb
macros.doc: Command for changing the punctuation after the second premiss (def=.).

macros.name: setsylrh
macros.doc: Command for changing the ‘width’ of the rule (def=.3pt).

macros.name: setsylsed
macros.doc: Command for changing the text that begins the second premiss.

macros.name: setsylsep
macros.doc: Command for changing the vertical space both before and after the syllogism to the same value.

macros.name: setsylsepa
macros.doc: Command for changing the vertical space before the syllogism (def=\baselineskip).

macros.name: setsylsepb
macros.doc: Command for changing the vertical space after the syllogism (def=\baselineskip).

macros.name: syllogC
macros.doc: The package also provides the command \syllogC which includes an automatic numeration feature.

macros.name: syllogTA
macros.doc: The command \syllogTA works almost exactly as \syllog, the only difference being that it adds some text to the second premiss and the conclusion.
